intro: Batatis checks whether a variance application is complete and cites the code. It does not judge whether a design is right. This page separates what Batatis guarantees by construction from what we measured, with how sure we are.

guaranteed.claim: Every code reference Batatis shows is checked against the NBC(AE) 2023, 2nd printing code database.
guaranteed.detail: An article number that is not in the database is removed from code identification and from assistant answers, or kept as the applicant’s own unchecked text. The exported form text passes the citation validator with zero errors.

guaranteed.claim: A made-up citation or quote from an AI model never reaches the screen.
guaranteed.detail: Tests replace the model with one that lies on purpose: invented article numbers, paraphrased or invented quotes. A pick is kept only when its quote appears word for word in the article. Over 30 random liars, nothing invented is shown.

guaranteed.claim: Section C objectives and functions come from a lookup in the code’s attribution tables, not from an AI model.
guaranteed.detail: Once an article is identified, its objective and function rows are read from the tables. Where a sentence has no row, Section C says so. Where the national intent differs, it is labelled.

guaranteed.claim: Batatis never fills a blank to make the form look complete.
guaranteed.detail: A value reaches the form only with a source in the applicant’s own words or files; a guess, or sources that disagree, wait for the applicant. A field shows N/A only when the applicant said it does not apply and gave a reason. The official form stays locked while a required field is empty.

guaranteed.claim: Batatis never writes the applicant’s case or the officer’s decision.
guaranteed.detail: The rationale, risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and limits are the applicant’s words. Text an AI drafted, or altered applicant text, is refused at export.

guaranteed.claim: Batatis never says a design complies, is safe, approved or adequate.
guaranteed.detail: The checker, the assistant, the coded rules, the checklists, the intake notes, the package review and the exported form are each tested for those words. It reports what is missing, not whether the design is right.

guaranteed.claim: Before the intake reader, code identification or the assistant sends text to an AI model, Batatis removes the names, contact details and addresses it recognizes.
guaranteed.detail: Known values from the application and the account are replaced too, including a name read from an uploaded file.

guaranteed.claim: The web app, code identification answers, the exported form and this report name no AI provider.
guaranteed.detail: Tests scan the web code that ships to the browser, the code identification responses, the exported PDF and this report for provider names.

tests.id: web/src/calm/no-provider-names.test.ts::the contributor accuracy report names no provider
tests.name: the contributor accuracy report names no provider

guaranteed.claim: A refused or failed run leaves no partial write.
guaranteed.detail: A run refused for a stale version, a rate limit or a concurrent edit changes nothing on the application. A failed model call stores no model facts and commits no article.

guaranteed.claim: Code identification does not pick an article on its own while its commit rule is uncalibrated.
guaranteed.detail: Until a calibration exists it offers at most three quoted choices, and the applicant decides.

guaranteed.claim: The coded rules give the same answer in the browser and on the server.
guaranteed.detail: Two evaluators, one in Python and one in TypeScript, run the same hand-set vectors and must produce identical output.

caveats: Provisional: 2 complete relevance draws per case on 139 cases; the plan asks for more draws, and the latency pass has not run.

The decision rule carries the product pipeline as provisional, not as a winner: it is tied with the best and the cheapest of those tied. It fails one robustness condition: two runs on the same case agree on the first article 84.6% of the time, under the required 90%. The choice needs a person.
The selection folds were used to choose the pipeline, so its number there is the best of several and flatters it. The development folds were not used to choose.
No committed-pick precision exists: the commit rule is uncalibrated, so Batatis commits nothing on its own.
The held-out test split has not been run. It runs once, after the commit rule is fitted.
Answer lists for public precedents can be incomplete, so a right answer can be scored as a miss.
measured.definition: A Part 9 case succeeds when the first article shown is a right one; any other case when a right article is among the three quoted choices. Each case scores the share of its runs that succeed.
measured.updates_when: The benchmark finishes: more relevance draws, the latency pass, then the decision memo. Re-run python scripts/accuracy_report.py and this section updates with no code change.

measured.title: Saying when an engineer is needed
measured.plain: Whether Batatis’s flag for professional involvement agrees with the labels, and how often it says no when the answer is yes (an under-flag).
caveats: It never answers no on these text-only cases. It answers yes or asks, so zero under-flags holds by construction, and 27 of 60 cases are sent to the applicant as a question.
Labels are model-written, not checked by an engineer.

measured.title: Coded rules
measured.plain: For five provisions applicants often vary, Batatis compares the applicant’s numbers with the acceptable solution and says whether the design follows or departs from it. Each rule is checked against vectors set by hand from the code text.
caveats: Unreviewed: 5 of 5 rules and 89 of 89 vectors are not yet signed by a domain reviewer (evals_dev/rules/REVIEW.md).
The vectors test the rules as coded. They do not show that a reading of the code is the right one.
The browser evaluator is checked against the server’s output for every vector.

measured.plain: Whether the three demo applications and one sample export cleanly to the official SCC form: every applicant field filled or marked N/A by the applicant, zero citation errors, and no compliance wording.
caveats: These are fictional example applications. They show the export works end to end, not that a real application is accurate.
